summary: Prevent Telegram rich-message truncation for long final replies
description: Production evidence at 2026-07-21 07:40 CEST: a 10,684-character table-heavy final was sent as one sendRichMessage and Telegram displayed only a fragment. Fail safe to legacy chunked delivery above the 4,096-character reliable message boundary.
acceptance: R1 rich final messages above 4096 UTF-16 units use numbered legacy chunks; R2 no content loss; R3 short rich tables remain rich; R4 stream overflow cannot accumulate a single unsafe Telegram final; R5 regression reproduces the 10684-character incident shape.

evidence.summary: Production root cause proven from 2026-07-21 07:40 CEST logs and state: a 10684-character table-heavy final was routed into one accepted sendRichMessage and Telegram displayed only a fragment. Rich send/edit delivery is now bounded to 4096 UTF-16 units; longer finals use existing numbered legacy chunks, including tail content. Stream overflow no longer raises the unsafe single-message cap. TDD RED reproduced the rich API call; GREEN proves head, section 64, and tail sentinel delivery. Verification: 203 Telegram rich/format/overflow/stream tests passed; go-workflow validate and git diff check passed.
